page.overview:
Who is Duasad Keef?

Duasad Keef () is a human noble of the Keef family from the Clovis Concord, and a member of the Golden Grin. He is a transgender man. Duasad is known for his empathic skills, which he uses to help people to go through their psychological challenges.

Duasad is a human man with an "acrobatic" build and a friendly smile. When Dorian first met him, Duasad wore his hair in a bun pulled to one side, and had on a shimmering bronze outfit over a light blue shirt.

In the summer of 843 PD, Duasad Keef appeared at the ball held by the Chandei Quorum in Jrusar attended by Bells Hells.
